comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The only recipe I know of for it is this (mostly Google Translated) one:

Making sacred trees
Recipe book Quarter Production Handicrafts
Skill / Rank Handicrafts r12
Era limited Mythical era
Ingredients: Greek goddess amulet x1 + Daedalus toolbox x2
Finished product: Athena's Tree x1

I've never thought to ask any of my Handicrafts friends to see if that recipe (or the one that uses Athena Trees to craft Pegasus Feathers, noted in the Athena Tree page's comments) ever showed up for them when the Mythical Era title was equipped, so I don't know whether or not it's in GAMA.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4932
